name: kanso-list-proposed
description: List everything you have proposed so far in this task, so you can revise it.

name: kanso-propose-merge
description: Propose merging several notes into one note. Nothing is written: the person reviews it. When they apply it, the source notes move to the Trash. Give the merged note's title and full text, and either `into` (an existing note to replace) or `bookId` (a notebook for a new note).

sources.description: 2 to 50 notes to combine, each with its _id and the _rev you read it at.

_rev.description: The revision you read the note at.

into.description: An existing note to replace with the merged text.

bookId.description: The notebook for the merged note, when it is a new note.

body.description: The merged note's full Markdown text. Cite each source as [[Title]].

name: kanso-propose-move
description: Propose moving a note to another notebook. Nothing is written: the person reviews it.

_rev.description: The revision you read the note at.

bookId.description: The notebook to move it to.

name: kanso-task-done
description: Say you are finished. Give a short summary of what you proposed and anything you were unsure about.

summary.description: A short summary for the person.
